The '''Governor's House''' was located in the [[Government Compound]] of [[Drepplin]], the capital city of [[Glova]]. It was the main government building and residence of the planet's [[Governor/Legends|governor]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] was [[Tegist Byrg]].
